goal: Implement front-desk pairing and verified membership lifecycle, including self unbinding and durable account deletion with recovery receipts.
dispatch_precondition: CP2 accepted at the exact baseline_commit; clean worktree verified before dispatch.
scope: Only /Users/orderly_ray/Projects/gym-miniapp; frozen PRD, complete acceptance matrix, checkpoint CP3 and technical contract govern. Native member and operator flows plus actual persistent backend are required.

Eight-digit leading-zero-safe pairing, 600-second expiry, one active request per account and one-use atomic consumption. Secure random generation and five collision attempts with rollback; encrypted temporary display and digest lookup. Same operation returns same code without logging it.
Persistent pairing generation and lookup/error limits per frozen parameters, counting under DB lock across processes/restarts. Distinguish unknown code, located requester and infrastructure errors.

MemberRegistry distinct from Binding; HMAC member reference normalized exactly as contract. Unique current binding per user and member key; revoked registry survives unbind/delete and cannot be overwritten by ordinary bind. Exact operator inspect supplies independently verified revisions.

Implement front-desk confirmation, bind, revoke, reverify, restore and expiry modes fixed_until/no_fixed_expiry/pending_confirmation. Explicit trusted time and date/time-zone conversion, no null-as-permanent or expired-as-valid.

Self unbinding and deletion require five-minute fresh authentication. Immediate deleting state revokes access, blocks recreation, and enqueues durable bounded deletion work; receipt securely generated and saved before submission, recoverable after lost response and valid seven days after completion.

Deletion clears personal associations/caches and sessions without restoring registry eligibility. Fresh identity after completed deletion has new userId and no inherited role/membership. Preserve minimal revoked memberKey. Persist cleanup cursors, errors and retry state; startup/hourly recovery follows contract.

All relevant mutations use scoped body digest, intent window, CAS and atomic audit/idempotency. Implement native normal/empty/expired/revoked/offline/conflict/unknown-result/refusal flows, current-state reads after operation results. Regression tests preserve CP0-CP2 behavior.
out_of_scope: No schedule implementation or later checkpoint functionality. No payments, door control, phone/face/location, QR scanning, automated gym-system integration or expanded role administration.
No real user/member data, real platform credentials, deployment/upload/publication or edits to frozen product baseline. New third-party dependencies require security gate.
acceptance: AC-M01/M02/R02: complete pairing-to-verification native/backend flow; collision rollback, exact expiry, terminal one-use, same-key display and both uniqueness constraints under actual concurrency.
AC-R01 pairing: persistent three creations/600s and five errors/600s operator/requester limits; lock-time window boundaries, restart/session switching and DB failure fail closed.
AC-M03/M04: revoked precedence, correct explicit expiry modes, authorized restore/reverify only, occupied-slot conflicts, cross-user/store/role denial and no identity/token disclosure.

AC-M05/X01/C02: fresh-auth boundaries, unbind/rebind, immediate deletion denial, lost-response receipt recovery, interrupted-job restart, concurrent login/write/delete ordering and no post-deletion role/qualification resurrection.

AC-L01/P01/D01/I01/C01 applicable membership layers: explicit purpose/refusal and cache erasure, independent clients and process restart, transaction rollback/operation replay, bounded cleanup with current revoked registry preserved.

Exact tested source manifest, prior regression checks, no unreviewed dependencies, final scoped clean local commit. Actual WeChat/tool/device/front-desk validation remains NOT_RUN unless separately authorized and evidenced.
evidence_required: RESULT COMPLETE/BLOCKED/PRODUCT_DECISION_REQUIRED; reports/cp3 with each AC and layer, base/final commit, file purposes, exact commands/exit codes and logs, synthetic fixture provenance, source hashes, scope deviations and unverified items.
Actual competing processes/HTTP clients and deletion failure/recovery; no raw member references, codes, tokens or real identity in evidence. Local scoped commit authorized for this task.
stop_conditions: Stop after CP3 delivery; do not begin CP4 until commander acceptance.
Stop affected path for product behavior/data-boundary conflict; report concrete required decision rather than silently weaken verification or deletion semantics.
